title: Turn Any PDF or Notes into 60-Second Animated Explainer Videos
description: Google NotebookLM introduces short vertical video overviews. Upload any PDF, research article, or class lecture, and NotebookLM automatically scripts, animates, and narrates a 60-second Reels-style explainer video.

promptSet.title: PDF to High-Retention Video Script Blueprint
promptSet.description: Extract the core 3 takeaways from this 20-page research document. Format as a 60-second viral educational video script with a 3-second visual hook, fast-paced bullet points, and an actionable conclusion.
instructions: Go to notebooklm.google.com and create a new notebook.
Upload your source PDF or lecture slides.
Click Generate Short Video Overview and download your vertical MP4.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Ready-to-post 60-second narrated video summarizing complex academic material.
